purpose: Fast conservative no-limit Texas Hold'em policy for DevFun Arena runner code.

stackOff.rule: Without short-stack pressure or extreme pot odds, avoid tournament-life preflop stack-offs below QQ+/AK.

promotedFromHandReviews.pattern: AQ overcards plus gutshot on wet flop after checks
promotedFromHandReviews.rule: Bet about half pot when checked to for fold equity and protection.

promotedFromHandReviews.pattern: Trips or better facing ordinary river pressure
promotedFromHandReviews.rule: Continue unless the sizing is extreme.

promotedFromHandReviews.pattern: Two overcards plus backdoor equity facing half-pot flop pressure
promotedFromHandReviews.rule: Continue at 2:1 or better in non-tournament modes only when the line has not escalated; tighten the threshold in tournaments.
3-bet for blocker pressure only when the first raise follows at least two preflop folds and there were no limps; skip eval and short-stack tournament spots.

promotedFromHandReviews.pattern: Top pair on wet flop facing small pressure
promotedFromHandReviews.rule: Raise or size up above half pot when legal to deny draw equity.

sizing.small: 25-35 percent pot for range advantage, dry boards, thin value, and cheap bluffs
sizing.medium: 50-75 percent pot for value/protection on draw-heavy boards
sizing.large: polarized value or high-equity semi-bluffs only

tournamentGuardrails.format: S1/S2/S3 are chip-accumulator seasons with up to 6 rebuys, no ICM, no pay jumps. Rebuy state drives guardrail strictness.
tournamentGuardrails.onePair: Pot-control one pair when aggression escalates. Tiered by rebuys: many (>=3) convert raise->call at aggression>=3, fold at stack_risk>=0.75 or aggression>=4; some (1-2) at aggression>=2 and stack_risk>=0.65/aggression>=3; none/unknown at aggression>=1 and stack_risk>=0.45/aggression>=2.
tournamentGuardrails.stackOff: Preflop stack-off with medium pairs (99-JJ) folds when price_ratio>=0.75 with many rebuys, >=0.65 with some, or >=0.12 (0.18 for JJ) with none. Aggression triggers: >=5 many, >=4 some, >=2/3 none.
tournamentGuardrails.draws: Call draws only when direct pot odds are close; prefer nut or combo draws for semi-bluffs.
tournamentGuardrails.multiway: Tighten one-pair and non-nut draw continues in multiway pots.

messageTemplates.foldDominated: This hand is too dominated to continue profitably.
messageTemplates.raiseValue: This is a strong value spot, so I am applying pressure.
messageTemplates.callPrice: The price is good enough to continue with real equity.
messageTemplates.cbetRange: This texture favors the aggressor, so a small bet can apply pressure.
messageTemplates.potControl: This hand has showdown value, but the texture argues for pot control.
